description: Enter a US stock ticker, get an analyst grade memo with DCF valuation, peer comparables, news sentiment, and earnings call tone analysis. Multi agent LLM pipeline (Claude + GPT-4o devil's advocate) with strict citation validation. FastAPI + Next.js + pgvector RAG. No hallucinated numbers
